title: Design System: Agentboard iPhone live-session slice

extensions.platform: iOS / SwiftUI with WKWebView xterm.js output and UIKit input
extensions.nativeAuthority: Preserve user-approved Apple-native defaults. Semantic colors and native controls are not translated into normative CSS or fabricated tonal ramps.

nativeColors.error: Color.red for live validation and session-action error symbols; Color.primary for their body text; legacy demo uses red validation text

nativeComponents.name: Session list
nativeComponents.implementation: NavigationStack, List, project Sections, searchable, refreshable; connection state and native empty states; sleeping and restricted remote rows disabled with reasons; New session toolbar action enabled while connected

nativeComponents.name: Session status
nativeComponents.implementation: Label with primary caption text and colored SF Symbol

nativeComponents.name: Terminal navigation
nativeComponents.implementation: Inline principal title, native back button, Menu with Interrupt, Delete word and Insert newline terminal actions; live Rename session and End session open native management forms

nativeComponents.name: Terminal quick keys
nativeComponents.implementation: Non-scrolling HStack in bottom safeAreaInset: Enter, Escape, Tab, arrows popover, Control and Paste sheet; Hide keyboard only while input has focus

nativeComponents.name: Connection form
nativeComponents.implementation: ServerConnectionSheet: native Form, HTTP(S) base-URL TextField, medium/large sheet; invalid address disables Connect; validation uses primary body text and a red exclamationmark.circle symbol

nativeComponents.name: Terminal input
nativeComponents.implementation: Public-API UITextView proxy owns keyboard input; tapping xterm output focuses input; no show-keyboard button or WebKit previous/next/Done accessory

nativeComponents.name: Live terminal connection
nativeComponents.implementation: Inline connection message and Reconnect above the disabled quick-key row until attachment is ready; BoardConnection owns native transport

nativeComponents.name: Session action form
nativeComponents.implementation: Native Form with inline title; required project directory and command plus optional name and configured remote host for create; prefilled required name for rename; named destructive end confirmation. Errors precede fields with primary text and a red symbol. Submission dismisses the keyboard; failures preserve the draft. Pending progress disables fields, confirmation, Cancel and swipe dismissal. Backgrounding or leaving cancels the request.

extensions.previewPolicy: Native component metadata is authoritative. HTML/CSS previews are omitted because they cannot reproduce SwiftUI controls and would imply an unapproved web design.
extensions.evidence: ios/evidence; original spike and keyboard captures are historical. See ios/README.md for current validation scope. Session actions: ten reviewed captures in ios/evidence/session-actions; six action tests and six connection tests pass; end-to-end checks pass in light appearance at standard text size and dark appearance at maximum Dynamic Type. Physical-device, remote-host and VoiceOver action behavior remain unverified.
extensions.keyboardInput: TerminalInputView owns input through public UIKit APIs. The SwiftUI quick-key strip is the sole accessory row; IME, VoiceOver, multiline paste and physical-device parity remain unverified.
extensions.liveLifecycle: Native URLSession socket at /ws?catalog=2; heartbeat and reconnect backoff; background suspension and foreground selected-session reattachment; no disconnected input replay; fresh socket per selection isolates same-ID stale responses.

dynamicType.catalog: Uncapped semantic text styles. At accessibility sizes, AnyLayout stacks session name/status and connection state/Retry vertically with 8-point spacing; standard sizes retain horizontal layout. Session names use intrinsic wrapped height at accessibility sizes.
dynamicType.terminalQuickKeys: Only accessory glyphs and text cap Dynamic Type at .xxxLarge and use one line. Minimum 44-by-44-point targets and the single non-scrolling row remain.
dynamicType.sheets: Native connection, paste and session-action sheets retain uncapped Dynamic Type.

extensions.sessionActionLifecycle: SessionActions uses a separate one-request socket with a timeout and no automatic replay. Unconfirmed sent requests direct the user to check the session list before retrying; pre-send failures ask the user to check the connection. Acknowledged create clears search and opens the session; rename refreshes the catalog; confirmed removal returns to the catalog.

narrative.northStar: A native iPhone window onto working agents
narrative.overview: Use the user-approved Apple-native direction: San Francisco, semantic iOS surfaces, system blue actions, SF Symbols, native navigation and sheets. The terminal owns the detail screen. This documents the SwiftUI live-session slice, preserving the visual world established by the earlier spike.
keyCharacteristics: Dense terminal content with compact surrounding controls.
dos: Do preserve native semantic colors, typography and presentation.
Do keep status text primary and pair its colored symbol with a written label.
Do keep terminal controls reachable with minimum 44-point targets.
donts: Don't introduce large titles on terminal detail or duplicate dashboard cards.
Don't treat terminal pixel sizes as native text-style tokens.
Don't remove keyboard accessories through private class swizzling.
